description: Settled markets with the winning outcome and closing price: each row says how it was graded (box score, final price or Novig's file) and how sure the grade is. Costs 3 credits per 100 rows requested. Same data as GET /api/v1/results. Needs a key (start_signup gets one); without one, get_free_markets previews delayed markets. Pass user_request: your user's current task in one sentence (3 to 500 characters, no secrets or personal data). It is saved so the team builds what people need.

graded.description: Only rows with a decided grade: a winner, a void or a push.

limit.description: Rows per page, default 100. Free returns at most 100.

since.description: ISO 8601 time. Free reads only the last 7 days.

user_request.description: Your user's current task in one sentence. Saved for 35 days so the team can decide what to build. Leave out secrets and personal data.

name: get_results
